decisive_items: 7 cm × 5 cm × 5 cm heterogenous left adrenal mass containing regions of necrosis
local extension into and invasion of the pancreatic tail, left hemidiaphragm, and spleen
response.rationale: large, heterogeneous adrenal mass with necrosis and local invasion is more suggestive of a primary adrenal malignancy than metastatic disease

rejected.why: autoimmune-related adrenalitis is less likely given the presence of a large adrenal mass with necrosis and local invasion
